fe38ca9e8664e774e9783b3db2315f1a94afa094.summary: Cisco Talos Incident Response describes a June 2022 Qakbot malspam campaign that hijacked old email threads, likely harvested from multiple organisations in the 2021 ProxyLogon-related Exchange compromises. The report calls this external thread hijacking, which differs from victim thread hijacking because the attacker does not need access to the target's own Exchange server. Emails come from spoofed external senders. The report gives defender tips: spoofed senders, old threads, few internal-to-internal threads, malformed replies, partly scrubbed addresses and reused threads. Its attribution…

hedges: Talos assesses the old emails were likely harvested in the 2021 ProxyLogon-related compromises; the selection process was not directly observed.
The assessment of ProxyLogon-harvested emails is based on observations such as email timing and research into publicly acknowledged compromises.
The attacker likely took the described steps; the email selection process could have used a regex search but was not directly observed.
The external thread hijacking approach is not necessarily specific to one adversary.
Talos expects that adversaries will likely continue to use bulk email aggregations from multiple organisations.
